thread:
incident-bot: Paging on-call: reranker-pipeline errors impacting batch endpoint /v1/embeddings/batch (high error rate). Investigating. Affected customers: 3 retail customers, some realtime rerank jobs stalled. Metrics: error-rate spike at 02:12 UTC. Priority: P1.

alex: I'm on it. Observed 5xx from batch worker pools, looks like failures start after recent bake at 01:45 UTC.

jeff: Seen the logs — lots of ValueError in reranker worker: 
```
ValueError: expected vector length 1024 but got 768
  at rerank/serializer.py:87
  at embed/runner.py:214
```
This smells like a mismatched embedder model variant rolled into the batch image.

sara: Confirming customer-reported failures: requests accepted but reranker returns 500, downstream task queue backlog growing. CS escalations landing in #support. Nina, any customer impact details?

nina: Two customers saw >50% of scheduled batches fail, third had intermittent failures on morning batch runs. They've flagged SLA misses; support already opened tickets and sent initial incident notice.

chao: Quick mitigation idea: route traffic for /v1/embeddings/batch to older image tag (stable-2026-03-12) or fall back to CPU embedder for the affected customers. Which is lower risk?

alex: Rolling back batch service to stable-2026-03-12 is simplest and fastest. I'll prepare a canary rollback for one pool first.

jeff: Before rollback, capture a sample failing payload and the model config blob to confirm vector dims. Run: 
```bash
kubectl logs deploy/rerank-batch-1 --tail=200 | grep "ValueError" -n
# capture failing payload id
kubectl exec -it pod/rerank-batch-1 -- cat /var/log/payloads/fail-<id>.json
```
We need the embedder model id in the payload and the model manifest used by the worker.

alex: Doing that now. Patch: set route rule to traffic-shift 100% to stable tag in staging pool then prod. Will post progress.

incident-bot: Action logged: alex started rollback of rerank-batch pool (action_id: act-1802345689). Please update with status.

jeff: Found sample payload. Model name: openembed-v2-1024; worker loaded openembed-v1-768. Mismatch confirmed. Payload excerpt: 
```json
{"model":"openembed-v2-1024","inputs":[...], "expected_dim":1024}
```
Worker manifest: 
```yaml
model: openembed-v1-768
vector_dim: 768
```

sara: That explains it. How did v1-768 get deployed to batch pools? Was there an automated image builder that picks latest manifest? Maria, did product roll any model pin changes?

maria: No intentional pin change. We recently enabled auto-variant selection for smaller latency models on low-memory pools (feature flag ff/model-variant-auto). Could be a config leak into batch pools. I'll check the rollout logs.

chao: Rolling back will stop new errors but backlog remains — we should also enqueue a worker job to reprocess failed batches after rollback or schedule retries. How many failed batches? alex, can you estimate?

alex: ~120 failed batches across two pools in the last 20 minutes. I'll start a retry job (rerank-retry-job) after rollback completes.

incident-bot: Update: rollback canary passed on pool-a (02:18 UTC). Rolling out to pool-b.

jeff: After rollback we should also scan for mismatched model manifests in other pools. Quick query: 
```sql
SELECT pool, deployed_model, manifest_dim FROM deployments WHERE deployed_at > '2026-03-12T00:00:00Z' AND pool LIKE 'batch%';
```
run that and share results.

maria: I see ff/model-variant-auto was enabled org-wide by mistake on 2026-03-11 during a test. Patching config to scope only to realtime pools now.

nina: Customer comms: Sent preliminary status email to affected customers and flagged for follow-up after RCA. They asked for ETA; told them 2h for full recovery (including retries).

sara: Good. Keep them updated and post RCA timeline draft in this thread. Also need a post-incident follow-up to prevent auto flags in batch pools.

chao: Rollback completed at 02:23 UTC. Error rate returning to baseline. Starting retry job for failed batches.

alex: Retry job started (job-id rerank-retry-1802345710). Monitoring queue reprocessing.

jeff: Hypothesis list so far:
- H1: auto-variant feature flag leaked into batch pools causing 768 model to be selected for payloads expecting 1024.
- H2: image-builder pipeline used latest manifest without validating compatibility across clients.
- H3: lack of deployment-time contract checks for expected vector dim between payloads and worker manifest.
Please add any other hypotheses.

maria: Adding H4: config scoping bug in feature flag rollout script.

nina: Customer-impact notes: SLA exposure for 3 customers, revenue-sensitive for one; escalate to AMs.

sara: Next steps:
1) Complete log captures and upload to incident bucket (alex).
2) Run wide scan for manifest/payload mismatches (jeff).
3) Patch feature flag scoping and add pre-deploy contract check in CI (chao + jeff).
4) Customer follow-up + postmortem draft (nina + maria).
Please mark ownership in thread.

alex: Uploaded logs to gs://redwood-incidents/1802345678/logs.tar.gz and attached sample payloads.

jeff: Running scan now, will post results in ~15m.

chao: I'll open a PR for CI pre-deploy contract check and link here. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4621 (WIP).

incident-bot: Next on-call handoff scheduled at 03:00 UTC. alex please leave a short handoff note before stepping off.

alex: Handoff: rollback done, retry job running, logs uploaded, customer comms sent. Monitoring error-rate — if it spikes re-open pager. Passing to jeff as secondary on-call.

jeff: I'll monitor for the handoff window and continue scan. Posting interim scan summary: found 3 other batch pools with mismatched manifests (pool-c, pool-d, pool-e) — opening incident tasks to rollback those and patch config.

maria: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and get timelines to AMs. Postmortem draft will include timeline, root causes (ff scoping + missing contract checks), impact numbers, and remediation plan.

nina: Support will follow up with affected customers with more precise ETA once retries finish.

sara: Great work team. Once postmortem draft is ready, we'll schedule a cross-functional review. For now, keep thread updated with any regressions.

incident-bot: Incident closed for pager at 02:40 UTC (status: mitigated). Please keep thread for RCA and follow-ups.
